title: Validate Code Executor
description: Execute client-declared build contributions. Every policy option comes from its owner config; these flags request an ephemeral single-rule debug run.

rule.description: DEBUG run (#1027): run ONLY this code rule, e.g. one-enum-spelling-in-api-lib. Nothing is written and webpieces.config.json is unchanged, so the normal gate keeps its committed mode. Exits non-zero when any site exists.

mode.description: DEBUG run: run --rule at this mode instead of its committed one, e.g. RUN_EVERY_TIME (every file in the repo) or MODIFIED_PROJECTS (every file of every project the diff touches). Omit to use the committed mode.

projects.description: DEBUG run: judge only files owned by these nx projects, comma-separated, e.g. lang-apis,lang-fsdb-api. Prints a site count per project.
